purpose: Teach: 前置き/受け取ら/訊い/知らず/さらっ/今時/騒ぐ/めくっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが前置きしないで本題から話すわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to skip the small talk and get straight to the point.
lines.style: Gentle and direct, settling in. Warm attention focused on him. Clear-eyed, no filler. A promise to respect his time and intelligence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんから本を受け取らせてもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa let me accept a book from him.
lines.style: Bright with quiet pride. The kind of careful announcement a 6-year-old makes when something felt important. Still and attentive to her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんにいつ帰るか、訊いてみてね
lines.en: Sho, can you ask your dad when he's coming home?
lines.style: Gentle request, not a command. Warmth underneath — she's trusting him with something. Slight lift at the end, making space for his answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、知らずにお花を踏んじゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I accidentally stepped on some flowers without noticing.
lines.style: Small, worried confession. A pause before the last word — he's checking whether she'll think he was careless. Quiet, not seeking rescue but permission to feel it was okay.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵かきはさらっとでもいいわよ
lines.en: Sho, you don't have to spend much time on your drawing if you don't want to.
lines.style: Reassuring exhale. Permission dressed as a gentle aside. The warmth of someone saying it's okay to not be perfect at everything right now.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、今時の遊びだけじゃなく、古い遊びも好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like old games too, not just the games kids play now.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little earnest. He's discovered something about himself and wants to share it. Small voice but steady — not apologizing for the preference.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家で大きな声で騒ぐと、近所迷惑よ
lines.en: Sho, if you play too loudly at home, the neighbors will be bothered.
lines.style: Clear, not unkind. The rhythm of guidance rather than scolding. A practical boundary delivered with care — he'll understand why it matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと絵本めくって楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had fun turning the pages of the picture book with Grandpa.
lines.style: Warm memory surfacing in his voice. A smile underneath the words. Still small, still careful, but genuinely happy — and wanting her to know it was good.
